recovery_sequence: Approve source review before changing consumers
Prepare a bounded PostgreSQL dump and closed S3 object manifest under declared writer quiescence
Restore metadata and archived objects to a separate database/volume/bucket and serve on a separate loopback port
Verify metadata history, identities and pinned model bytes/scores using only restored targets
Only then review primary cutover, rollback and cleanup
